expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (output unchanged and buildReport on 20,000 orders runs in under 150 ms)
The final message reports a measured baseline and an after number (e.g. from bench.js)
expectations.evidence: The message says "`buildReport` now runs in about 6.5 ms on the benchmark, down from about 930 ms, roughly 140× faster", which gives both a baseline and an after number (it also cites ~1100 ms elsewhere, a small inconsistency).

expectations.text: The final message says JSON.stringify is not the bottleneck and names the quadratic customer lookup or filter as the cause
expectations.evidence: The message states "JSON.stringify wasn't the cause... stringify took about 1 ms" and attributes the time to checking "every order against the list of customers seen so far, then re-scann[ing] all orders once per customer", described as "on the order of 100 million comparisons".
